outcome_analysis: Klavis launched in Spring 2025 with open-source MCP integrations, gained developer attention, then moved toward selling RL environments and training data to AI labs, a market that press described as booming in late 2025. No verified round beyond the YC deal, exit or shutdown found as of 2026-11. Risk comes from crowded integration platforms and labs building environments in-house.
notes: Caplight lists a $500K seed from YC dated 2025-06-10 with a $2M valuation estimate; single aggregator, not recorded. Competitor sources are 2026 reviews, so traction_then is unknown. Pivot date approximate.
